title: Which supplier invoices above the contract price
prompt: Every supplier is contracted at the same unit price per SKU: SKU-100 12.50, SKU-200 7.25, SKU-300 31.00. Which supplier invoices above the contract price? Use the data in invoice_lines.csv. Base every number on the file, not on a guess. End your answer with exactly one line of the form `VERDICT: <answer>`, where <answer> is one of: Norfield, Oakmont, Pinecrest, Quayside.
